item.title: Benscoter announces candidacy for 117th district
item.description: HUNLOCK CREEK — Jeremy Benscoter has announced he is running as a Democrat for State Representative in the 117th Legislative District.

item.title: Rep. Pugh seeks reelection to continue her work for Luzerne County families
item.description: DALLAS TWP. — Stating she is “honoring her promise to always put the best interests of local residents and taxpayers first,” longtime businesswoman and Rep. Brenda Pugh has announced her bid for reelection in the 120th Legislative District.

item.title: Rollercoaster offseason ends as NASCAR returns with Clash
item.description: DAYTONA BEACH, Fla. — There’s no telling what version of Denny Hamlin will race this upcoming NASCAR season, which unofficially begins Wednesday night with The Clash, an exhibition race held at grassroots Bowman Gray Stadium in North Carolina.

item.title: New York Giants are hiring Matt Nagy as offensive coordinator
item.description: The New York Giants are hiring Matt Nagy to be their offensive coordinator, according to a person with knowledge of the decision.

item.title: Some Luzerne County Council members seeking anti-discrimination ordinance
item.description: Some Luzerne County Council members are seeking to implement a countywide anti-discrimination ordinance.

item.title: Harden to Cavs, Garland to Clippers in deal of All-Star guards
item.description: James Harden is headed to the Cleveland Cavaliers, with the Los Angeles Clippers agreeing to send the 11-time All-Star back to the Eastern Conference during his highest-scoring season in six years, a person with knowledge of the agreement said Tuesday night.

item.title: Hollenback Twp. residents mobilize against data centers ahead of public hearing
item.description: HOLLENBACK TWP. — Residents turned out in droves to the monthly supervisor’s meeting Tuesday to voice their concerns over the potential construction of data centers ahead of a public hearing regarding a zoning amendment that would regulate the facilities in the township.

item.title: H.S. Boys Basketball: Wyoming Area surges past Holy Redeemer to WVC Division 2 title
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — One of the Wyoming Valley Conference’s most electrifying players explained Tuesday’s power surge in the third quarter.

item.title: Krall: Pennsylvania has leadership, momentum, and legislation for cleaner waters at home and the Chesapeake Bay
item.description: With Governor Josh Shapiro becoming chair of the Chesapeake Bay Program’s Executive Council and Senator Gene Yaw (R-Lycoming) elected to lead the tri-state Chesapeake Bay Commission for 2026, Pennsylvania is front and center in efforts to reduce pollution flowing into local waters and the Chesapeake Bay.

item.title: Test Kitchen: A big game party recipe, Hot Honey Chicken
item.description: First Super Bowl I remember watching any part of: 1971. Closing in on my 13th birthday, I had spent the day out in the cold with Boy Scout Troop 16 (probably ice-skating). We stopped at someone’s house before heading home and the game was on the TV. My older brother rooted for the Baltimore Colts over the Dallas Cowboys, so I did too. Colts clopped away with the win.
